name: commit-msg
description: Writes an accurate conventional commit message for your staged changes, using the Claude session that made them to explain why. Matches your repo's commit style; edit, regenerate and copy it from a pane. /commit-msg [simple|body|full] [note].

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the message.

style.title: Default style
style.description: The message style the pane starts on: subject only, subject and body, or subject, body and footer.

useSession.title: Use session context
useSession.description: Write the message from this Claude session, so it explains why the changes were made; the diff still decides what it describes. Runs on the session's model. Off, or with no session yet, the Model above writes from the diff alone.
